meta.title: TiCrafter Architecture Graph
meta.description: Canonical decomposition of TiCrafter systems, owned components, state ownership, typed relations, templates, tunables, and process boundaries.

forbiddenEdges.reason: Planner emits plans and tasks only.
Planner cannot write SIP state; it proposes mutations.
Bot processes use coordinator transport, not SQLite.
Perception emits observations; it cannot write SIP state.
Skills emit effects; coordinator owns SIP writes.
Training is dev-only and not imported by runtime.
Agency proposes goals only; skills perform actions through the executor.
Agency cannot write SIP state; it proposes personal projects through the coordinator.
Chat never triggers physical actions directly.

invariants: All actions pass through the typed coordinator authority chain; no component bypasses it.
Restart never accepts new work before claims, grants, sessions, and SIP revision are revalidated.
failureModes: Authority dependency unavailable: fail closed, keep serving read-only status, and surface a typed error.
tests: Authority-boundary contract test proving bypass attempts are rejected.

invariants: Every message validates against a versioned zod schema before dispatch.
Transport carries proposals and commands; it never owns domain state.
failureModes: Schema mismatch or framing error: reject the frame, close the connection, and record the protocol error.
tests: Round-trip encode/decode plus malformed-frame rejection.

invariants: Writes are transactional and use the coordinator transaction manager.
Reads never expose uncommitted state.
failureModes: Storage failure: abort the transaction, leave prior state intact, and return a typed repository error.
tests: Repository contract test with rollback, concurrency, and stale-read cases.

invariants: Validation is pure and deterministic; the same input yields the same verdict.
Invalid input is rejected with a typed reason and causes no partial mutation.
failureModes: Unknown rule or malformed input: reject closed with an actionable reason.
tests: Table-driven accept/reject fixtures including boundary and malformed inputs.

invariants: All writes commit in one SQLite transaction under the current coordinator epoch.
A stale fencing token or revision aborts the entire transaction.
failureModes: Conflict or stale token: abort, leave state unchanged, and return a retryable conflict error.
tests: Atomic commit, rollback, and stale-token rejection tests.

invariants: Claims and leases mutate only under the coordinator epoch and a valid fencing token.
Expired leases are reclaimed without losing audit history.
failureModes: Lease conflict or stale token: reject the commit, requeue the work, and record contention.
tests: Concurrent acquisition, expiry, and stale-commit race tests.

invariants: Privilege decisions are deny-by-default and scoped to one design revision.
Revocation takes effect immediately through a fencing-token bump.
failureModes: Policy ambiguity or missing owner: deny the request and return a typed reason.
tests: Grant/deny matrix including owner-offline and revision-bump cases.

invariants: Observed state and intended SIP state stay separate; merges never overwrite active plan tags.
Landmark confidence decays and conflicting evidence is flagged for re-verification.
failureModes: Conflicting observations: keep the newest with evidence and flag the landmark for verification.
tests: Merge, decay, conflict-resolution, and spatial-query fixtures.

invariants: Detectors are pure over a chunk snapshot and emit evidence with confidence.
Detection never mutates world state; it only emits landmark candidates.
failureModes: Insufficient evidence: emit nothing rather than a low-confidence landmark.
tests: Fixture-based detector precision and recall checks.

invariants: One Laya model instance exists fleet-wide and at most one forward pass is in flight.
Model output is advisory; typed parsing rejects free text.
failureModes: Timeout, crash, or low confidence: fall back to deterministic policy and record the downgrade.
tests: Typed output parsing, timeout fallback, and single-inflight tests.

invariants: Planner output is untrusted JSON, schema-validated before any SIP or task proposal.
Planner never writes blocks and never mutates SIP directly.
failureModes: Invalid plan: repair at most twice, then keep the last good plan.
tests: Schema rejection, repair-loop, and budget-cap tests.

invariants: Skills execute through the lifecycle executor with veto checks before every effect.
Checkpoints capture resumable state and restore is validated against the observed world.
failureModes: Skill failure: classify, checkpoint when resumable, and report to Laya or the planner.
tests: Lifecycle, preemption, checkpoint/restore, and failure-class tests.

invariants: The skill declares canRun/plan/step/cancel and checkpoint/restore with typed effects.
Every effect passes the guardian veto gate before reaching the action executor.
failureModes: Precondition loss or blocked path: cancel cleanly and report the failure class.
tests: Happy path, blocked path, and checkpoint-resume fixtures.

invariants: Building is support-first and idempotent; blocks already correct are skipped.
No load-bearing block of an occupied structure is removed without a valid grant.
failureModes: Unreachable target or missing material: pause the package and request refill or replan.
tests: Blueprint diff, ordering, idempotency, and rollback tests.

invariants: The adapter is the only path to mineflayer; higher tiers issue typed actions only.
Reach and action-rate guards run before every physical action.
failureModes: Disconnect or blocked action: stop the skill and reconnect with backoff.
tests: Adapter contract tests with mocked mineflayer and rate-limit cases.

invariants: Guardian evaluation runs at 20Hz and outranks Laya and the planner.
No destructive action executes without passing the veto gate.
failureModes: Hazard detected: veto the action, record the incident, and enter the recovery ladder.
tests: Guardian invariant tests per hazard class and veto precedence.

invariants: The brain layer emits proposals only; it never calls mineflayer.
Deterministic policy is always available as the fallback path.
failureModes: Model or profile unavailable: use the deterministic utility policy and record the downgrade.
tests: Affordance enumeration, utility fallback, and Laya-client timeout tests.

invariants: All domain writes go through repositories and coordinator-owned transactions.
Event logs and block changelogs are append-only.
failureModes: SQLite or migration failure: fail closed at startup, or abort the write at runtime.
tests: Migration, WAL mode, retention, and append-only tests.

invariants: Ops endpoints never mutate domain state except through explicit control components.
Metrics and logs are non-blocking; loss is bounded and recorded.
failureModes: Metrics sink or logger unavailable: drop telemetry without blocking fleet work.
tests: Endpoint contract, pause/stop, and telemetry-failure tests.

invariants: Configuration is validated once at startup; missing secrets fail fast.
No component reads process.env outside the config loader.
failureModes: Missing or invalid configuration: exit non-zero with an actionable error.
tests: Profile matrix, missing-secret, and schema-validation tests.

invariants: Harnesses use disposable servers and deterministic fixtures.
Benchmarks record hardware profile, execution provider, and p50/p95.
failureModes: Environment unavailable: skip with an explicit reason; never pass silently.
tests: Self-tests for fixture setup and metric reporting.

invariants: Training is dev-only and is never imported by runtime.
Exported ONNX bundles are immutable artifacts with recorded provenance.
failureModes: Training or export failure: leave the last bundle intact and report the failure.
tests: Dataset, export, and artifact-checksum tests.

invariants: Runs only against repo-local dependencies and caches.
Fails closed with actionable diagnostics instead of mutating the host.
failureModes: Missing or mismatched pinned artifact.
Insufficient disk space or unavailable runtime prerequisite.
tests: Bootstrap is idempotent on a clean checkout.
Bootstrap fails fast when a required prerequisite is missing.

stateMapping.bot_events: SQLite table bot_events; append-only event log.
stateMapping.episodes: SQLite table episodes; outcome traces for replay and training export.
stateMapping.agent_state: SQLite table agent_state; current needs, intention, routine, home, and mood per bot.
stateMapping.agent_episodes: SQLite table agent_episodes; append-only episodic memories for agency and replay.
stateMapping.sip.*: The single logical sip table is stored as sip.zones, sip.structures, sip.roads, sip.farms, sip.containers, sip.pathGraph, sip.rules, and sip.revisions.

systems.name: Coordinator Runtime
systems.purpose: Own the single coordinator process, route commands, schedule work, and recover fleet state after restart.
invariants: One coordinator process is the only authority for fleet state commits.
Every restart revalidates claims, grants, and bot sessions before accepting work.
Commands are routed through typed handlers; no component bypasses the authority chain.

components.name: Process Bootstrap
components.responsibility: Load config, open SQLite, run migrations, start transport, and enter a healthy serving state.

components.name: Service Composition
components.responsibility: Wire coordinator services through explicit interfaces and reject missing or cyclic runtime dependencies.

components.name: Bot Session Manager
components.responsibility: Authenticate bot sessions, track connection state, and notify presence and recovery components.

components.name: Command Router
components.responsibility: Route validated commands to the owning authority: SIP commit, task claim, claim acquisition, or grant issuance.

components.name: Coordinator Epoch Authority
components.responsibility: Issue and persist the coordinator epoch used to invalidate stale leases and grants after restart.
invariants: The coordinator epoch increments exactly once per start and is embedded in every fencing token.
Tokens from a previous epoch are rejected after restart.

components.name: Global Scheduler
components.responsibility: Coordinate periodic reconciliation, lease expiry, planner triggers, and retention jobs without overlapping runs.

components.name: Restart Recovery Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Recover leases, grants, bot profiles, tasks, and SIP consistency before normal work resumes.
invariants: No new work is accepted until leases, grants, bot sessions, tasks, and SIP revision are revalidated.

components.name: Backpressure Controller
components.responsibility: Apply fleet-wide queue and action backpressure when decision, transport, or claim latency exceeds budget.
invariants: When warm-model p95 exceeds 250ms fleet-wide, tactical rate drops before any confidence-gate change.

components.name: Bot Process Supervisor
components.responsibility: Spawn, supervise, and terminate bot child processes and report crashes over IPC.
invariants: Each bot runs in its own child process and is supervised over IPC.
A crashed bot is restarted or killed and its claims expire by lease; the fleet keeps running.
failureModes: Spawn or supervision failure: mark the bot offline, release no state directly, and let leases expire.
tests: Spawn, crash-detect, kill, and restart-isolation tests.

systems.name: Transport and Protocol
systems.purpose: Define typed messages and move requests, responses, deltas, and events between coordinator and bots.
invariants: Every cross-process message validates against a versioned schema before dispatch.
Transport carries proposals and commands; it never owns domain state.
Reconnect and delta sync are idempotent and safe under retry.

components.name: Message Schema Registry
components.responsibility: Version and expose zod schemas for coordinator-bot requests, responses, events, and deltas.

components.name: WebSocket Codec
components.responsibility: Encode, decode, and validate WebSocket frames against registered message schemas.

components.name: Request Correlator
components.responsibility: Match requests to responses with stable correlation IDs and bounded pending state.

components.name: Event Stream
components.responsibility: Publish and deliver ordered domain events with per-consumer cursors and backpressure.

components.name: Delta Sync Protocol
components.responsibility: Package and apply state deltas by chunk version, SIP revision, task board revision, and grant revision.
invariants: Delta sync is keyed by chunk version, SIP revision, task revision, and grant revision and is idempotent under retry.

components.name: Reconnect Supervisor
components.responsibility: Reconnect with exponential backoff and force delta resync after any gap.

components.name: Transport Authentication
components.responsibility: Authenticate bot sessions by identity and reject connections that do not match a known bot profile.

components.name: Flow Control
components.responsibility: Bound in-flight requests and queue depth per bot and per message class.

systems.name: Shared Infrastructure Plan
systems.purpose: Maintain the canonical intended world state and commit validated plan revisions atomically.
invariants: Every committed change increments the SIP revision exactly once.
A mutation is proposed, validated, then committed transactionally; no partial SIP writes.
Active plans are tagged separately from observed natural infrastructure.

components.name: Zone Store
components.responsibility: Persist zones, polygons, priorities, and no-build constraints.

components.name: Structure Store
components.responsibility: Persist structures, design revisions, ownership, status, work packages, and collaboration policy.

components.name: Road Store
components.responsibility: Persist road polylines, widths, materials, segment status, and owners.

components.name: Farm Store
components.responsibility: Persist farm plots, crops, water sources, growth state, and assigned bots.

components.name: Container Registry
components.responsibility: Persist canonical container roles, reservations, and contents snapshots.

components.name: Path Graph Store
components.responsibility: Persist the SIP path graph nodes and edges used for routing and road planning.

components.name: Rules Store
components.responsibility: Persist protected bounding boxes, allowed edits, and safety constraints.

components.name: SIP Revision Manager
components.responsibility: Allocate monotonic revisions, reject stale proposals, and publish revision changes.
invariants: Revisions are monotonic; stale proposals are rejected and revision changes invalidate outstanding grants.

components.name: Spatial Overlap Validator
components.responsibility: Reject mutations that overlap protected zones, active structures, or disallowed edits.

components.name: Dependency Validator
components.responsibility: Reject mutations that violate structure, road, farm, container, or path-graph dependencies.

components.name: SIP Mutation Proposer
components.responsibility: Accept untrusted mutation proposals and attach actor, plan, grant, and idempotency metadata.

components.name: SIP Transactional Committer
components.responsibility: Validate a proposal and commit all SIP stores in one SQLite transaction with a fencing token.
invariants: Every committed SIP change increments the revision exactly once inside one SQLite transaction.
A proposal with a stale revision or fencing token is rejected without partial writes.

components.name: SIP Reconciliation Engine
components.responsibility: Compare observed world against intended SIP state and update progress, deviations, and revisions.
invariants: Reconciliation compares observed world with intended SIP state and never mutates observed state.

systems.name: Task Board
systems.purpose: Maintain the fleet work DAG and offer eligible jobs without duplicate execution.
invariants: A task is claimed by at most one bot at a time.
Task transitions are persisted before they are acknowledged.
Dependencies and preconditions gate eligibility before a claim is allowed.
Jobs are offers: bots may accept, defer, or decline with a reason.
Declining a job is not a task failure and never changes task state.

components.name: Task Repository
components.responsibility: Persist tasks, dependencies, state, retries, priority, and dead-letter status.

components.name: Task DAG Resolver
components.responsibility: Resolve task dependencies and expose eligible roots without cycles.

components.name: Precondition Evaluator
components.responsibility: Evaluate world, inventory, zone, and claim preconditions before task eligibility.

components.name: Priority Scheduler
components.responsibility: Order eligible tasks by priority, role fit, distance, and fleet contention.

components.name: Atomic Task Claimer
components.responsibility: Claim the next eligible task in one transaction and issue the task lease.

components.name: Job Offer Service
components.responsibility: Offer ranked eligible jobs to a bot and record accept, defer, and decline decisions without changing task state on decline.
invariants: Offers are advisory and never reserve a job.
Accepting an offer claims the job in one transaction with a lease and fencing token.
Declining records a reason and leaves the job available for another bot.

components.name: Retry Manager
components.responsibility: Retry failed tasks with bounded backoff and failure-class-specific policy.

components.name: Dead Letter Manager
components.responsibility: Park exhausted tasks for planner review instead of retrying forever.

components.name: Task State Machine
components.responsibility: Validate and persist every legal task transition with actor and reason.

systems.name: Claims and Leases
systems.purpose: Prevent duplicate work through atomic claims, leases, heartbeats, and fencing tokens.
invariants: Acquisition and overlap checks happen in one SQLite transaction.
A commit with a stale fencing token is rejected.
Expired leases return resources to planned state without losing audit history.

components.name: Claim Repository
components.responsibility: Persist claims, resource types, bounding boxes, leases, status, and fencing tokens.

components.name: Overlap Margin Checker
components.responsibility: Reject claim requests that overlap an active claim or safety margin.

components.name: Atomic Claim Acquirer
components.responsibility: Acquire a resource claim atomically after overlap and task eligibility checks.
invariants: Overlap checks and claim acquisition share one SQLite transaction with the configured safety margin.

components.name: Lease Heartbeat
components.responsibility: Renew active leases only while the owning bot remains connected and valid.

components.name: Lease Reaper
components.responsibility: Expire overdue leases, requeue work, and invalidate fencing tokens.

components.name: Fencing Token Authority
components.responsibility: Issue monotonic fencing tokens bound to coordinator epoch and claim identity.
invariants: Fencing tokens are monotonic and bound to coordinator epoch and claim identity.

components.name: Claim Releaser
components.responsibility: Release a claim on completion, cancellation, or bot loss and requeue uncompleted work.

components.name: Bot Claim Command Handler
components.responsibility: Accept typed claim acquire, renew, and release requests from bots and route them through the claim service.
invariants: Bot-originated claims use the same overlap, lease, and fencing rules as job claims.
A bot cannot acquire or release a claim for another bot.

components.name: Contention Metrics
components.responsibility: Record claim wait, reclaims, duplicate attempts, and lease churn.

systems.name: Edit Grants and Collaboration
systems.purpose: Allow scoped, revision-bound edits to active builds without corrupting owner plans.
invariants: Active builds are private by default.
Every non-owner edit presents an unexpired grant bound to the current design revision and fencing token.
A design revision change invalidates outstanding grants immediately.

components.name: Grant Repository
components.responsibility: Persist edit grants, scopes, operation sets, revisions, expiries, and fencing tokens.

components.name: Collaboration Policy Evaluator
components.responsibility: Apply private, invite, or open policy to an edit request.

components.name: Compatibility Checker
components.responsibility: Verify proposed edits preserve invariants, do not undo work, and do not collide with claimed packages.
invariants: Compatibility requires matching design revision, no undone completed work, no claimed work-package collision, and preserved structural invariants.

components.name: Design Revision Guard
components.responsibility: Bind grants to one design revision and revoke grants when the revision changes.
invariants: Any design revision change invalidates all outstanding grants for that structure.

components.name: Grant Issuer
components.responsibility: Issue a scoped grant after policy and compatibility approval.
invariants: Every grant is scoped to a bbox, an allowed operation set, and exactly one design revision.
Issued grants carry a fencing token bound to the coordinator epoch.

components.name: Grant Revoker
components.responsibility: Revoke a grant immediately by bumping its fencing token.

components.name: Owner Offline Policy
components.responsibility: Deny by default when the owner is offline unless persisted policy explicitly accepts compatible helpers.
invariants: Owner-offline edits default to deny; they are allowed only when autoAcceptCompatibleHelpers is true and compatibility passes.

components.name: Grant Expiry
components.responsibility: Expire grants by TTL and reject writes that arrive after expiry.

components.name: Arbitration Adapter
components.responsibility: Escalate ambiguous compatibility decisions to the planner without bypassing safety rules.

systems.name: Bot Registry and Profiles
systems.purpose: Persist bot identity, personality, needs, intention, roles, behavior, relationships, presence, home, and resume state.
invariants: Bot identity and username assignment are stable across restarts.
Resume restores intent, needs, home, and obligations, then reconciles with the world.
Profiles, roles, and agency state are coordinator-owned and persisted continuously.

components.name: Bot Identity Authenticator
components.responsibility: Authenticate a bot by stable bot ID and username against persisted identity.

components.name: Bot Profile Store
components.responsibility: Persist identity, role, behavior, task, claims, grants, relationships, and sync cursors.

components.name: Role Manager
components.responsibility: Persist fixed roles and apply temporary planner reassignment with restoration.

components.name: Behavior Profile Manager
components.responsibility: Persist risk tolerance, work radius, sociability, and preferred base.

components.name: Relationship Store
components.responsibility: Persist trust and interaction history between bots.

components.name: Presence Tracker
components.responsibility: Track online, offline, and suspended state from session events.

components.name: Delta Sync Planner
components.responsibility: Compute the state delta a reconnecting bot needs from persisted cursors.

components.name: Resume Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Restore profile, leases, task, grants, and skill checkpoint; requeue if stale.

components.name: Agency State Store
components.responsibility: Persist current needs, intention, routine, home, mood, and last deliberation time per bot.
invariants: Agency state writes are transactional and never expose partial snapshots.
Restored intentions are marked for world reconciliation before resuming.

components.name: Name Pool Allocator
components.responsibility: Assign names by stable bot index and reject pools shorter than bot count.

systems.name: World Model and Landmarks
systems.purpose: Merge observations into one queryable world model and landmark registry.
invariants: Newest valid observation wins; older conflicting observations decay.
Observed world state is separate from intended SIP state.
Every landmark carries confidence, evidence, and last-seen metadata.

components.name: Observation Ingestor
components.responsibility: Ingest validated chunk snapshots and block updates from bot perception.

components.name: Chunk Version Store
components.responsibility: Persist per-chunk snapshots, versions, and sparse occupancy deltas.

components.name: Sparse Occupancy Grid
components.responsibility: Maintain the sparse 3D occupancy view used for spatial queries.

components.name: Merge Conflict Resolver
components.responsibility: Resolve competing observations by recency, confidence, and source reliability.

components.name: Confidence Decay
components.responsibility: Decay landmark and observation confidence over time and flag re-verification.

components.name: Landmark Registry
components.responsibility: Persist landmarks, anchors, evidence, confidence, and plan tags.

components.name: Detector Result Integrator
components.responsibility: Turn detector candidates into landmark registry mutations.

components.name: Plan Tagging
components.responsibility: Tag observed blocks that belong to an active plan as in-progress rather than natural infrastructure.
invariants: Blocks belonging to an active planId are tagged in-progress and are never classified as natural infrastructure.

components.name: Spatial Query Engine
components.responsibility: Answer nearest, inside-base, route, protected, container, and ownership queries.
invariants: Spatial queries expose nearest, insideBase, route, isProtected, containerAt, and whoOwns without mutating state.

components.name: Container Memory
components.responsibility: Track observed container positions, roles, and contents snapshots.

components.name: World Reconciler
components.responsibility: Compare observed state with intended state and emit deviation findings.

systems.name: Perception
systems.purpose: Sample loaded chunks, detect infrastructure, and emit structured observations.
invariants: Perception never writes world state directly; it emits observations.
Sampling respects the configured ring and per-bot rate budget.
Detectors are deterministic functions over chunk snapshots.

components.name: Ring Sampler
components.responsibility: Sample loaded chunks within the configured 16-64 block ring without exceeding rate budget.

components.name: Chunk Snapshot Encoder
components.responsibility: Encode sparse chunk snapshots with version and evidence metadata.

components.name: Block Update Listener
components.responsibility: Turn relevant block updates into incremental observation events.

components.name: Path and Road Detector
components.responsibility: Detect standable-surface corridors with length, width, and material hints.

components.name: House Detector
components.responsibility: Detect enclosed interiors, shells, doors, beds, windows, and roofs.

components.name: Farm Detector
components.responsibility: Detect farmland moisture, adjacent water, crop age, and plot clusters.

components.name: Storage and Workstation Detector
components.responsibility: Detect chest, barrel, furnace, and crafting-table clusters.

components.name: Linear Structure Detector
components.responsibility: Detect walls, bridges, and mineshafts through PCA, RANSAC, and deck-over-air checks.

components.name: Detector Pipeline
components.responsibility: Run detectors in a bounded order and merge candidates without duplicate landmarks.

components.name: Landmark Candidate Emitter
components.responsibility: Emit deduplicated landmark candidates with confidence and evidence.

components.name: Perception Rate Limiter
components.responsibility: Cap sampling and detector work per bot according to hardware profile.

systems.name: Laya Decision Service
systems.purpose: Run one shared Laya model, serialize inference, and return calibrated choices over needs, goals, and actions.
invariants: One Laya instance exists fleet-wide; never one instance per bot.
Only one inference forward pass is in flight at a time.
Low-confidence or timed-out decisions fall back to deterministic utility policy.
Laya advises among goal candidates and actions; it never owns motivation or execution.

components.name: Model Loader
components.responsibility: Load the Laya ONNX bundle from the configured model directory.
invariants: One shared Laya ONNX model is loaded per coordinator; providers are cpu on home-min and webgpu,cpu on home-full.
CPU fallback is always registered and intraOp threads are 3 on home-min and 8 on home-full.

components.name: Execution Provider Selector
components.responsibility: Select CPU or WebGPU according to profile, availability, and measured p95.
invariants: WebGPU is adopted only if it beats CPU p95 and runs 2h without crash or driver reset; otherwise CPU is used.
failureModes: WebGPU init, crash, or slower p95: downgrade to CPU automatically and log the downgrade.

components.name: Decision Queue
components.responsibility: Order decision requests by priority with per-bot rate limits and bounded depth.

components.name: Decision Rate Limiter
components.responsibility: Enforce fleet-wide and per-bot decision rates for the active hardware profile.

components.name: Digest Cache
components.responsibility: Cache normalized state digests to avoid repeated tokenization work.

components.name: Digest Assembler
components.responsibility: Validate and normalize the bot state digest, needs, goal candidates, and actions into a bounded inference request.
invariants: The state digest is at most 512 tokens and carries 8-16 goal or action candidates, each at most 12 words.
Needs are summarized as bounded ratios; goal candidates are typed and de-duplicated.

components.name: Batch Runner
components.responsibility: Batch questions from one decision request into a single forward pass.

components.name: Single In-flight Guard
components.responsibility: Block concurrent forward passes and enforce timeout around the model session.
invariants: At most one Laya forward pass is in flight per coordinator at any time.

components.name: Output Parser
components.responsibility: Parse typed choice, score, and noul outputs without accepting free text.
invariants: Only typed choice, score, and noul outputs are accepted; free text is rejected.
Choice cardinality stays at or below 16 and total option tokens at or below 192.

components.name: Confidence Calibrator
components.responsibility: Apply per-question temperature and compute calibrated answer confidence.
invariants: Per-question temperature is fitted on held-out traces.
A calibrated confidence below 0.60 routes the bot to its deterministic utility policy.

components.name: Timeout and Fallback Handler
components.responsibility: Return a fallback signal when inference exceeds budget or confidence is below gate.
invariants: A decision request that would break the 250ms warm p95 budget is timed out and falls back to deterministic policy.

components.name: Latency Metrics
components.responsibility: Record p50, p95, queue wait, provider, and fallback rate.

systems.name: Cloud Planner Advisor
systems.purpose: Turn fleet-level context and events into optional strategic goals, validated SIP revisions, and opt-in job offers.
invariants: Planner output is untrusted until schema and semantic validation pass.
Planner never writes blocks or commits SIP state directly.
Planner work is advisory: bots may defer or decline jobs.
Invalid output keeps the last known good plan after bounded repair attempts.

components.name: OpenAI-Compatible Client
components.responsibility: Call the configured planner endpoint with timeouts, cancellation, and no default URL.

components.name: Planner Context Builder
components.responsibility: Build a bounded fleet context from SIP, tasks, world queries, and bot profiles.

components.name: Planner Trigger Evaluator
components.responsibility: Trigger planning on interval, conflict, failure burst, death cluster, landmark, or chat request.

components.name: Planner Schema Validator
components.responsibility: Validate strict JSON planner output against the versioned zod schema.

components.name: Planner Semantic Validator
components.responsibility: Reject plans with unknown skills, infeasible materials, bad distances, zone violations, or budget overruns.

components.name: Planner Repair Loop
components.responsibility: Attempt at most two schema or semantic repairs before keeping the last good plan.
invariants: Invalid planner output gets at most two repair attempts before the last good plan is kept.

components.name: SIP Mutation Translator
components.responsibility: Translate validated plan intent into SIP mutation proposals.

components.name: Task DAG Translator
components.responsibility: Translate validated plan intent into task board proposals.

components.name: Planner Budget Limiter
components.responsibility: Enforce calls per minute, token caps, timeouts, cancellation, and cost accounting.
invariants: Planner calls obey calls-per-minute, token, timeout, cancellation, and cache budgets.

components.name: Plan Cache
components.responsibility: Cache validated plans and recent planner responses for reuse and recovery.

components.name: Planner Arbitration Handler
components.responsibility: Arbitrate ambiguous edit compatibility once without bypassing safety rules.

components.name: Keep Last Good Fallback
components.responsibility: Restore the last validated plan when planner output cannot be repaired.
invariants: A failed planner cycle never replaces the last validated plan.

components.name: Strategic Intent Store
components.responsibility: Keep the latest validated strategic intent, merge per-bot overrides, and deliver it on resume and planner commit.
invariants: Only validated intent is stored and delivered.
Fleet intent merges with bounded per-bot overrides.

systems.name: Skill Runtime
systems.purpose: Run skills through a typed lifecycle with ticks, checkpoints, interruption, and effects.
invariants: Every skill runs through canRun, plan, start, step, cancel, checkpoint, and restore.
Skills emit typed effects; they never mutate SIP or claims directly.
The guardian can preempt or veto a skill at any tick.

components.name: Skill Contract
components.responsibility: Define the typed skill interface, failure classes, progress events, and effects.

components.name: Skill Registry
components.responsibility: Register and resolve skills by stable ID and validate contract compliance.

components.name: Skill Lifecycle Executor
components.responsibility: Execute skill plan, start, step, cancel, and completion transitions.

components.name: Skill Tick Scheduler
components.responsibility: Step active skills at 200-500ms while preserving guardian priority.

components.name: Skill Context Builder
components.responsibility: Build the bounded skill context from world, SIP, inventory, task, and checkpoint state.

components.name: Skill Progress Reporter
components.responsibility: Report progress and failure class to Laya, planner, and metrics.

components.name: Skill Checkpoint Manager
components.responsibility: Persist and load skill checkpoints by bot, task, and skill.

components.name: Skill Restore Validator
components.responsibility: Reject stale checkpoints that no longer match the world or claim state.

components.name: Typed Effects Emitter
components.responsibility: Emit declared place, break, use, attack, and inventory effects.

components.name: Skill Preemption Handler
components.responsibility: Cancel or pause a skill when the guardian, claim, or grant state changes.

systems.name: Skill Library
systems.purpose: Implement the v1 deterministic skills used by bots.
invariants: Skills are idempotent where possible and report progress and failure class.
Skills request actions through the bot runtime; they do not touch mineflayer directly.
Skills respect claims, grants, and safety vetoes.

components.name: Navigate
components.responsibility: Move a bot to a target position using pathfinding and stuck recovery.

components.name: Follow Path
components.responsibility: Follow a SIP path graph route with waypoint and deviation handling.

components.name: Mine
components.responsibility: Mine a targeted block with tool selection, reach checks, and drop collection.

components.name: Collect
components.responsibility: Collect nearby drops or resource blocks within a bounded area.

components.name: Craft
components.responsibility: Craft an item from a recipe using available inventory and workstations.

components.name: Smelt
components.responsibility: Smelt input items in a reachable furnace with fuel accounting.

components.name: Eat
components.responsibility: Consume the best available food when hunger or health requires it.

components.name: Deposit
components.responsibility: Deposit selected inventory into a reserved container.

components.name: Withdraw
components.responsibility: Withdraw requested materials from a reserved container.

components.name: Sleep
components.responsibility: Reach and use a bed safely when night or threat requires it.

components.name: Flee or Defend
components.responsibility: Flee, kite, or defend against hostile mobs according to role and risk.

components.name: Explore
components.responsibility: Explore unknown territory while avoiding protected and claimed areas.

components.name: Bridge
components.responsibility: Place a safe bridge across a gap or obstacle without violating safety rules.

components.name: Clear
components.responsibility: Remove permitted blocks from a work package after grant and safety validation.

components.name: Place Build
components.responsibility: Place blueprint blocks for a work package in support-first order.

components.name: Construction
components.responsibility: Execute an ordered construction plan through verified block changes and scaffold cleanup.
invariants: Construction restores by re-diffing the world instead of replaying stale coordinates.
Every block change carries claim, grant, blueprint revision, and fencing attribution.

components.name: Schematic Build
components.responsibility: Execute a schematic-backed blueprint with diffing and partitioning.

components.name: Repair
components.responsibility: Repair a structure by diffing intended blueprint against observed blocks.

components.name: Harvest Farm
components.responsibility: Harvest mature crops from an assigned farm plot.

components.name: Plant Farm
components.responsibility: Plant seeds and maintain water and crop state on an assigned plot.

components.name: Entity Targeting
components.responsibility: Find and track the nearest matching entity and verify that a target still exists.

components.name: Equip Gear
components.responsibility: Equip the best available weapon and armor into the correct slots.
invariants: Only inventory items may be equipped and no slot is filled with an incompatible item.

components.name: Gather Food
components.responsibility: Hunt passive animals and collect their drops until enough food is carried.
invariants: Gathering stops at the requested food count and never attacks players or bots.

components.name: Gather Wool
components.responsibility: Shear or hunt sheep for wool and skip already-sheared targets.
invariants: A sheared target is not retried indefinitely and gathering stops at the requested wool count.

components.name: Place Bed
components.responsibility: Move to the target cell and place a carried bed with support-safe placement.
invariants: A bed is placed only when a bed item is carried and the target cell is reachable.

components.name: Dig Shelter
components.responsibility: Dig a sealed two-block pocket, wait out the night, then unseal and refill it.
invariants: Each dug block is recorded and restored when the shelter is left.
Digging advances only after the current break action completes.

components.name: Skill Shared Utilities
components.responsibility: Provide target selection, inventory math, reach checks, and progress helpers.

systems.name: Building
systems.purpose: Represent blueprints, compose templates and schematics, partition work, and execute block changes safely.
invariants: Every block change is support-first, verified, rate-limited, and journaled.
Work packages are claimed before execution and idempotent on retry.
No destructive change bypasses grants, safety, or protected bounding boxes.

components.name: Blueprint IR
components.responsibility: Define the validated blueprint intermediate representation of blocks, materials, and constraints.

components.name: Blueprint Validator
components.responsibility: Validate blueprint blocks, constraints, materials, and zone compatibility.

components.name: Template Registry
components.responsibility: Register and resolve procedural building templates by type.

components.name: House Template
components.responsibility: Generate parameterized house walls, roof, door, windows, and interior.

components.name: Road Template
components.responsibility: Generate parameterized road and path segments.

components.name: Farm Template
components.responsibility: Generate a parameterized 9x9 farm with water and crop layout.

components.name: Wall Template
components.responsibility: Generate parameterized defensive walls.

components.name: Bridge Template
components.responsibility: Generate parameterized bridges with support and deck rules.

components.name: Storage Room Template
components.responsibility: Generate a parameterized storage room with container placement.

components.name: Watchtower Template
components.responsibility: Generate a parameterized watchtower with safe access.

components.name: Template Instantiator
components.responsibility: Instantiate a template with size, material, anchor, and rotation into a blueprint.

components.name: Schematic Parser
components.responsibility: Parse .schem and optional .litematic files into blueprints.

components.name: Schematic Diff
components.responsibility: Diff blueprint against world blocks to compute missing and extra blocks.

components.name: Work Package Partitioner
components.responsibility: Split a blueprint into claimable layers, slices, or quadrants.
invariants: Multi-bot builds split into claimable packages by layers, perimeter slices, or quadrants.

components.name: Build Order Planner
components.responsibility: Order blocks support-first and bottom-up with dependency constraints.

components.name: Reachability and Scaffold Planner
components.responsibility: Plan safe reachability and scaffold fallback for each block target.

components.name: Block Verifier
components.responsibility: Verify target block state before and after placement or removal.

components.name: Block Executor
components.responsibility: Execute verified block changes through the bot action executor with safety veto and rollback.
invariants: Block placement is support-first, bottom-up, reachability-planned, and idempotent.
Placement respects protected bboxes, active bot support, and material bans.

components.name: Material Preflight
components.responsibility: Check inventory and containers for required materials before starting a package.

components.name: Container Refill Adapter
components.responsibility: Withdraw missing materials and deposit surplus through deterministic skills.

components.name: Rollback Journal
components.responsibility: Journal every block before/after image for reversible changes.
invariants: Every destructive change records block before/after, actor, grantId, planId, and timestamp and is rollback-capable.

components.name: Construction Plan Types
components.responsibility: Define site, foundation, dependency, scaffold, procurement, and construction-plan contracts.

components.name: Blueprint Document
components.responsibility: Version, hash, source, and persist blueprint documents with provenance and construction phases.

components.name: Seeded Random
components.responsibility: Provide deterministic random values for identical briefs and seeds.

components.name: Style Palette
components.responsibility: Resolve style profiles into deterministic structure, floor, roof, accent, and glass palettes.

components.name: Motif Library
components.responsibility: Provide reusable door, window, stair, bed, storage, lighting, farm, and roof motifs.

components.name: Blueprint Composer
components.responsibility: Compose a compact building brief into a validated, deterministic, functional blueprint.

components.name: Observed Blueprint
components.responsibility: Capture existing structures into blueprints for repair, renovation, and imitation.

components.name: Blueprint Source Resolver
components.responsibility: Resolve template, composed, schematic, observed, and gated raw-block blueprint sources.

components.name: Site Planner
components.responsibility: Select a deterministic site, reject hazards and protected zones, and adapt access and foundation needs.

components.name: Foundation Planner
components.responsibility: Plan foundation fills, cuts, clearance, and foundation materials without mutating the canonical blueprint.

components.name: Construction Dependency Graph
components.responsibility: Order construction changes by support, attachments, multi-block objects, phases, and explicit dependencies.

components.name: Work Package Planner
components.responsibility: Partition ordered construction changes into phase-aware packages without splitting dependency stacks.

components.name: Construction Plan Planner
components.responsibility: Combine site, foundation, blueprint, scaffold, and package planning into one ordered construction plan.

components.name: Construction Plan Document
components.responsibility: Version, hash, and persist site-adapted construction plans with namespaced package identity.
invariants: Construction plans are fetched by exact revision.
Package IDs are namespaced by plan ID.

components.name: Material Procurement Planner
components.responsibility: Convert material shortages into withdrawals, crafting, gathering, reservations, or blocking failures.

systems.name: Bot Runtime and Mineflayer Adapter
systems.purpose: Own each bot child process, mineflayer lifecycle, local state digest, affordances, and action execution.
invariants: No model or planner calls mineflayer directly.
The 20Hz guardian runs locally and can veto any action.
Actions are rate-limited and validated for reach and safety before execution.

components.name: Connection Lifecycle
components.responsibility: Create, join, maintain, and close the mineflayer connection.

components.name: Join and Auth
components.responsibility: Join the LAN server with the assigned identity and offline auth.

components.name: Mineflayer Event Bridge
components.responsibility: Translate mineflayer events into typed local and coordinator events.

components.name: World Cache Adapter
components.responsibility: Expose local block, chunk, entity, and inventory state to perception and skills.

components.name: Shelter Inspector
components.responsibility: Inspect the home bounding box for shelter and bed state and find a safe nearby dig site.
invariants: Shelter is reported only while the bot is inside or next to the home bounds.
Dig sites exclude water, lava, bedrock, and storage blocks.

components.name: Reach and Rate Guard
components.responsibility: Reject impossible reach and enforce configurable action rates.

components.name: Action Executor
components.responsibility: Execute only safety-approved place, break, use, attack, and movement actions.
invariants: The action executor is the only path to mineflayer and enforces reach and action-rate limits.

components.name: Building Execution Service
components.responsibility: Prepare, verify, journal, and complete block changes for construction skills.
invariants: Block changes are verified before and after execution and journaled with attribution.
Claim fencing tokens are required whenever a claim id is present.

components.name: Blueprint Fetch Client
components.responsibility: Fetch and cache exact blueprint document revisions from the coordinator.
invariants: Blueprint fetches require an exact id and revision and never fall back to the latest revision.
Fetched documents are hash-checked before caching.

components.name: Construction Plan Fetch Client
components.responsibility: Fetch and cache exact construction plan revisions from the coordinator.
invariants: Plan fetches require an exact id and revision.
Fetched plans are hash-checked before caching.

components.name: Construction Source
components.responsibility: Derive package, cleanup, and replacement operations from a fetched exact construction plan.
invariants: Construction starts from a cached exact construction plan revision.
Mismatched existing blocks become break-then-place operations.

components.name: State Digest Collector
components.responsibility: Collect health, food, time, biome, y-level, target, inventory, hazards, and skill progress.

components.name: Guardian Hook
components.responsibility: Connect the local reflex guardian to the action veto gate on every tick.

components.name: Skill Host
components.responsibility: Host the skill runtime inside the bot process and step active skills.

components.name: Perception Host
components.responsibility: Host the perception sampler and detector pipeline inside the bot process.

components.name: Agent Loop
components.responsibility: Run the local agency tick, decide between personal goals and jobs, and drive intention execution through skills.
invariants: The agent loop never blocks the 20Hz guardian and never calls mineflayer directly.
Urgent needs preempt jobs and personal goals; the guardian preempts everything.
No job is accepted without a local utility decision and a valid lease.

components.name: Goal Tie-Break
components.responsibility: Ask Laya to choose among close agency goal candidates and fall back to the deterministic arbiter winner on error, stale revision, or disabled configuration.
invariants: Only close goal candidates are presented to Laya.
A stale revision or focus change discards the Laya choice.
The deterministic arbiter winner is always available.

components.name: Chat Adapter
components.responsibility: Send and receive typed social messages through mineflayer chat with rate limits and no physical actions.
invariants: Chat never triggers a physical action directly and never echoes arbitrary input.
Chat is rate-limited per bot and can be muted by ops.

components.name: Agency State Adapter
components.responsibility: Load and persist agency snapshots through coordinator state and reconcile intention with the observed world.
invariants: Restored intentions are validated against the observed world before resuming.
Agency state writes go through coordinator persistence, never local SQLite.

components.name: Reconnect Supervisor
components.responsibility: Reconnect after disconnect and trigger delta resync and resume.

systems.name: Autonomy and Safety
systems.purpose: Guarantee deterministic survival reflexes, safety invariants, and veto authority over all actions.
invariants: Guardian priority is always above Laya and planner.
No destructive action executes without passing the veto gate.
No fire, lava, or TNT unless explicitly enabled.

components.name: Hazard Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect lava, void, fall, and drowning risk from the current world snapshot.

components.name: Mob Threat Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect hostile mobs, threat distance, and escape options.

components.name: Hunger Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect critical hunger and food availability from the bot snapshot.

components.name: Stuck and Timeout Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect stuck movement, path timeout, and unreachable targets.

components.name: Inventory Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect full inventory or missing required tools and materials.

components.name: Claim Loss Evaluator
components.responsibility: Detect lost or expired claims and stop work that no longer owns its resource.
invariants: Losing a claim or edit grant immediately stops work that depends on it.

components.name: Protected BBox Rule
components.responsibility: Reject actions inside protected, no-build, or active work-package bounding boxes.

components.name: Active Bot Support Rule
components.responsibility: Reject breaking blocks that support or occupy an online bot.
invariants: Blocks supporting an online bot are never broken.

components.name: Material Ban Rule
components.responsibility: Reject fire, lava, TNT, and other banned materials unless explicitly enabled.
invariants: Fire, lava, and TNT are forbidden unless explicitly enabled in configuration.

components.name: Safety Policy Engine
components.responsibility: Evaluate protected bboxes, support rules, active-bot exclusion, and material bans.

components.name: Action Veto Gate
components.responsibility: Reject any action that fails guardian, safety policy, claim, or grant validation.
invariants: Guardian has final veto over Laya and planner actions.
No destructive or mineflayer-bound action executes without passing the gate.

components.name: Recovery Ladder
components.responsibility: Escalate from local retry to Laya alternative, planner replan, safe mode, then emergency stop.

components.name: Emergency Stop Controller
components.responsibility: Stop a bot or the fleet safely and require explicit resume.

components.name: Incident Journal
components.responsibility: Record safety incidents, vetoes, and recovery escalation with actor context.

systems.name: Memory and Persistence
systems.purpose: Provide SQLite WAL persistence, migrations, transactions, logs, changelogs, and retention.
invariants: All domain writes use repositories and coordinator-owned transactions.
Event log and block changelog are append-only.
Retention prunes only expired logs; state persists until manual pruning.

components.name: SQLite Runtime
components.responsibility: Open SQLite in WAL mode with bounded connections and busy timeout.

components.name: Migration Runner
components.responsibility: Apply versioned migrations deterministically and record schema version.

components.name: Transaction Manager
components.responsibility: Provide atomic transactions and fail-closed rollback for domain commits.

components.name: Event Log Writer
components.responsibility: Append normalized domain events with actor, timestamp, and causation ID.
invariants: bot_events is append-only and records decisions, task transitions, grants, and failures with actor and timestamp.

components.name: Block Changelog Writer
components.responsibility: Append block before/after images with grant, claim, and rollback metadata.

components.name: Retention Pruner
components.responsibility: Prune event logs and block changelogs after 30 days without touching current state.
invariants: Event logs and block changelogs are pruned after 30 days; current SQLite state is never pruned automatically.

components.name: Snapshot Export
components.responsibility: Export consistent snapshots for backup, replay, and evaluation.

components.name: Schema Version Registry
components.responsibility: Track and validate the applied database schema version.

components.name: Episode Store
components.responsibility: Persist task episodes and outcome traces for replay, evaluation, and training export.
invariants: Episodes are append-only outcome traces tied to bot, task, and episode id.
Episode retention follows the same 30-day log policy.

components.name: Agent Episode Repository
components.responsibility: Persist append-only episodic memories for needs, intentions, discoveries, deaths, gifts, chats, and goal outcomes.
invariants: Agent episodes are append-only and tied to bot, goal, and episode id.
Episode retention follows the same 30-day log policy.

systems.name: Ops and Observability
systems.purpose: Expose fleet status, controls, metrics, logs, health, and audit views.
invariants: Ops controls can pause or stop work but cannot bypass safety policy.
Status and metrics are read-only views over coordinator state.
Every pause, resume, and emergency stop is audited.

components.name: Ops API
components.responsibility: Expose status, pause, resume, stop, SIP dump, and metrics endpoints.

components.name: Status Aggregator
components.responsibility: Aggregate bot, task, claim, grant, SIP, and decision status for operators.

components.name: Agency Status View
components.responsibility: Expose current needs, intention, routine, home, goal outcomes, and chat rate per bot.
invariants: Agency status is read-only and never mutates needs or intention.

components.name: Pause and Resume Controller
components.responsibility: Pause or resume one bot or the fleet without corrupting claims.

components.name: Fleet Emergency Stop
components.responsibility: Trigger a fleet-wide safe stop through the safety authority.
invariants: Fleet emergency stop halts all bots, revokes active action authority, and is itself audited.

components.name: SIP Dump
components.responsibility: Render a read-only snapshot of the current SIP revision.

components.name: Metrics Registry
components.responsibility: Collect counters, gauges, and histograms for tasks, claims, decisions, and safety.

components.name: Structured Logger
components.responsibility: Emit structured pino logs with bot, task, claim, and trace identifiers.

components.name: Health and Readiness
components.responsibility: Report coordinator, database, model, and transport health for startup and probes.

components.name: Audit Viewer
components.responsibility: Read event and block changelog views for incident and rollback review.

systems.name: Config and Profiles
systems.purpose: Validate environment, hardware profiles, secrets, bot names, and Laya runtime settings at startup.
invariants: Config is loaded once at startup and validated before services start.
No component reads process.env directly outside the config loader.
Missing secrets or invalid profiles fail fast with an actionable error.

components.name: Environment Parser
components.responsibility: Parse environment variables and optional config/.env without logging secrets.

components.name: Config Schema Validator
components.responsibility: Validate the merged config against the versioned schema.

components.name: Profile Resolver
components.responsibility: Resolve home-min or home-full profile values and apply defaults.

components.name: Hardware Probe
components.responsibility: Probe CPU, memory, and WebGPU availability for runtime selection.
invariants: Hardware profile is detected or read from HARDWARE_PROFILE and drives Laya providers and thread counts.

components.name: Secrets Loader
components.responsibility: Load planner base URL and API key from process env or gitignored config/.env.
invariants: PLANNER_BASE_URL and PLANNER_API_KEY have no defaults and are loaded from process env or gitignored config/.env.
failureModes: Missing planner secret: fail fast with an actionable error before any planner call.

components.name: Name Pool Validator
components.responsibility: Validate that the ordered bot name pool is long enough for bot count.

components.name: Laya Runtime Resolver
components.responsibility: Resolve execution providers and thread counts for the active profile.
invariants: LAYA_EP auto resolves to webgpu,cpu on home-full and cpu on home-min; explicit values are honored.
Thread counts come from the active hardware profile, not constants.

components.name: Fail Fast Handler
components.responsibility: Abort startup with a precise reason when required config is missing or invalid.

systems.name: Testing and Evaluation
systems.purpose: Run deterministic scenarios, contention tests, benchmarks, replays, and soak tests.
invariants: Every solver-critical invariant has a deterministic test fixture.
Integration tests run against a disposable 1.20.1 offline superflat server.
Benchmarks record p50 and p95 with hardware profile and provider metadata.

components.name: Unit Fixtures
components.responsibility: Provide shared fixtures for SIP, claims, grants, blueprints, and guardian invariants.

components.name: Detector Fixtures
components.responsibility: Provide golden chunk snapshots for each perception detector.

components.name: Docker Server Harness
components.responsibility: Start and stop a disposable itzg/minecraft-server 1.20.1 offline superflat server.

components.name: Scenario Runner
components.responsibility: Run multi-bot scenarios with deterministic setup and teardown.

components.name: Replay Engine
components.responsibility: Replay event logs and block changelogs for regression analysis.

components.name: Contention Harness
components.responsibility: Stress claims, task board, and decision queue under 4-bot and 8-bot load.

components.name: Metrics Reporter
components.responsibility: Collect and report task success, duplicates, contention, deaths, and latency.

components.name: Soak Runner
components.responsibility: Run 2+ hour stability tests and detect memory growth, deadlocks, and claim drift.
invariants: Soak runs 4 bots on home-min and 8 on home-full for at least 2 hours with no memory growth or deadlock.

components.name: Architecture Guard Tests
components.responsibility: Assert dependency rules, forbidden edges, and graph coverage in CI.

components.name: Laya Benchmark Harness
components.responsibility: Measure warm-model p50 and p95 for CPU and WebGPU with stability gates.
invariants: Hard gates are warm-model p95 below 250ms and 2h with no crash or driver reset.
WebGPU is adopted only if it also beats CPU p95.

systems.name: Laya Training
systems.purpose: Dev-only trace export, labeling, fine-tuning, ONNX export, calibration, and promotion.
invariants: Training is dev-only and never imported by the runtime.
The runtime loads only the exported ONNX bundle.
A new model is promoted only if it beats the deterministic baseline end-to-end.

components.name: Trace Exporter
components.responsibility: Export state digest, affordances, chosen action, and outcome traces.
invariants: Trace export reads runtime data but never becomes a runtime dependency.

components.name: Labeling Pipeline
components.responsibility: Label exported traces with cloud teacher labels and outcome rewards.

components.name: Reward Computer
components.responsibility: Compute progress, damage, time, material, and completion rewards.

components.name: Fine-tune Runner
components.responsibility: Fine-tune Laya in Python using labeled traces and reward signals.

components.name: ONNX Exporter
components.responsibility: Export the fine-tuned model into the models/ ONNX bundle.

components.name: Calibration Fitter
components.responsibility: Fit per-question temperature on held-out traces.

components.name: Promotion Gate
components.responsibility: Promote an ONNX bundle only after benchmark and calibration gates pass.

systems.name: Brains
systems.purpose: Own reflex, affordances, deterministic decision fallback, and the bot-side Laya client.
invariants: Brain components emit proposals and never call mineflayer directly.
Deterministic policy is always available when Laya is unavailable, late, or low-confidence.
Reflex guardian outranks agency, Laya, and the planner.

components.name: Reflex Guardian Loop
components.responsibility: Run deterministic safety checks at 20Hz and issue veto or recovery signals.
invariants: The reflex guardian runs at 20Hz per bot and can veto any skill or Laya action.
Guardian failure is fail-safe: stop actions rather than continue unguarded.

components.name: Affordance Enumerator
components.responsibility: Enumerate 8-16 legal actions with short labels for the decision service.
invariants: Affordances are legal, typed, and limited to 8-16 options of at most 12 words each.

components.name: Deterministic Policy
components.responsibility: Choose a legal action from utility scores when Laya is unavailable, late, or low-confidence.
invariants: Deterministic utility policy is always available and is used when Laya is unavailable, late, or below 0.60 confidence.

components.name: Laya Client
components.responsibility: Submit decision requests to the coordinator Laya service and apply typed responses with timeout fallback.
invariants: The bot-side Laya client never blocks the 20Hz guardian and falls back to deterministic policy on timeout.
failureModes: Coordinator unreachable or decision timeout: use deterministic policy and reconnect.

components.name: Tactical Decision Policy
components.responsibility: Enforce tactical Laya enablement, profile mode, deadlines, rate limits, single-affordance skip, and circuit breaking.
invariants: Background advisory never blocks task start, agency tick, or the guardian.
Repeated failures open the tactical circuit breaker.

systems.name: Agency
systems.purpose: Turn needs, personality, memory, world context, and social signals into goal candidates, committed intentions, routines, and social proposals without executing actions.
invariants: Agency components emit proposals only; they never call mineflayer or write SIP state.
Deterministic utility is always available when Laya is unavailable, late, or below the confidence gate.
Needs, intention, routine, home, and social state survive restart and are reconciled before resumption.
Agency never bypasses the reflex guardian.

components.name: Personality Model
components.responsibility: Seed, validate, and expose persistent personality traits that weight needs, goals, risk, and chat style.
invariants: Traits are seeded deterministically from bot index, persisted, and always bounded to 0..1.
Traits modulate utility and style but never override the guardian.

components.name: Needs Model
components.responsibility: Maintain homeostatic need levels, decay them over time, and apply satisfaction events.
invariants: Need levels are bounded to 0..1 and decay deterministically with elapsed time.
Need satisfaction never decreases unrelated needs.

components.name: Goal Catalog
components.responsibility: Define typed goal templates, their skill steps, costs, risks, and expected values.
invariants: Every goal template names an existing skill id and bounded typed input.

components.name: Goal Generator
components.responsibility: Emit concrete goal candidates from needs, personality, world context, time, home, and social signals.
invariants: Generation returns 1-16 legal candidates and rejects infeasible or unsafe goals.

components.name: Goal Arbiter
components.responsibility: Score goal candidates with utility, personality, commitment hysteresis, cost, and risk.
invariants: Selection is deterministic for the same inputs and keeps an active goal until completion, abandonment, or preemption.
Laya advice is requested only when top scores are close or after repeated failure.

components.name: Intention Manager
components.responsibility: Track the active goal, step index, retries, completion, abandonment, preemption, and expiry.
invariants: Only one intention is active per bot.
Every completion or abandonment records a typed reason and timestamp.

components.name: Routine Model
components.responsibility: Derive morning, day, evening, and night phases and expose work, rest, and social preferences.
invariants: Routine phase is a pure function of time of day and is a prior, not a script.

components.name: Item Knowledge
components.responsibility: Classify food, weapons, armor, wool, beds, and building materials from the bot inventory.

components.name: Night Preparation Config
components.responsibility: Define night preparation thresholds, material requirements, and shelter strategy switches.

components.name: Shelter Strategy
components.responsibility: Choose keep, build, dig-in, or none from shelter state, daylight left, and available material.
invariants: Build is chosen only when enough daylight and material remain.
Dig-in is chosen only when a safe dig site is available.

components.name: Shelter Plan
components.responsibility: Generate a bounded support-first shell of blocks for a first shelter.
invariants: Shelter blocks are ordered support-first and bounded to a small footprint.

components.name: Night Readiness
components.responsibility: Assess home, shelter, bed, food, combat, and hostile gaps and emit ordered night preparation actions.
invariants: Readiness is a pure assessment and never calls a skill directly.
Every emitted action names a supported skill id and typed input.

components.name: Social Engine
components.responsibility: Classify social messages, generate personality-styled replies, and enforce chat rate limits.
invariants: Social output is typed, rate-limited, and never echoes arbitrary input.
Social behavior never triggers a physical action outside the skill pipeline.

components.name: Working Memory
components.responsibility: Track bounded focus, commitments, interruption, recent experience, and tactical revision for continuity across goals and restarts.
invariants: The revision increments on every focus, commitment, interruption, and experience change.
Commitments and recent experiences stay within their configured bounds.
Missing persisted working memory restores to an empty memory.

components.name: Project Focus Policy
components.responsibility: Keep long-lived project focus as agency focus while allowing bounded survival and routine interruptions.
invariants: Project focus never creates a second goal manager.
Project sub-work does not replace project focus.
Survival goals may interrupt project focus and restore it when complete.

components.name: Agency State
components.responsibility: Aggregate personality, needs, intention, routine, home, mood, working memory, and deliberation status into one snapshot.
invariants: Agency state snapshots are immutable and restart-safe.

components.name: Strategic Intent Policy
components.responsibility: Apply validated fleet and per-bot strategic priorities and constraints to goal generation and tactical context.
invariants: Intent never interrupts an active intention.
Priority modifiers stay bounded.

components.name: Reflection
components.responsibility: Turn goal completion and abandonment into mood, bounded personality trait changes, and recent experience.
invariants: Reflection is deterministic and local.
Traits stay bounded to 0..1 and each update respects the configured maximum delta.
Reflection failure never blocks goal completion or abandonment.

systems.name: Bootstrap and Toolchain
systems.purpose: Provision every dependency and app into repo-local paths, verify pinned artifacts, and operate the local Minecraft test server.
invariants: All dependencies and apps install into gitignored repo-local paths.
Bootstrap never performs global installs or invokes a system package manager.
Every download matches a pinned checksum from tools/bootstrap/manifest.json.
Runtime processes never depend on toolchain components.

components.name: Bootstrap Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Detect missing dependencies and apps, enforce disk guards, and provision repo-local install roots.

components.name: Capability Check
components.responsibility: Report required and optional capabilities, installed artifacts, and free disk without modifying state.

components.name: Python Environment
components.responsibility: Create a repo-local virtualenv and install pinned training requirements for the selected PyTorch variant.

components.name: Minecraft Server Controller
components.responsibility: Start, stop, and inspect the repo-provisioned local Minecraft 1.20.1 test server with explicit EULA consent.

components.name: Firefox SVG Renderer
components.responsibility: Render Mermaid source to SVG using the installed Firefox browser without downloading Chromium.
